title: InstrumentOptimisation
description: Vendor view: how lab throughput responds when one instrument's spec changes in a given lab setup, and which change is worth most.

parameter.description: cycle_time scales the instrument's step durations; capacity adds parallel slots.

value.description: Multiplier for cycle_time/transfer_time/uptime, absolute slots for capacity.

elasticity.description: % throughput change per % improvement near baseline; ~0 means this spec is not the limit here.

headroom_note.description: Plain-language takeaway for the vendor, e.g. 'beyond 30% faster, the LC-MS becomes the bottleneck'.

next_bottleneck.description: Instance that limits throughput once this instrument is improved.
